definitions.selected: Every original audited query, including missing, corrupt, excluded and unresolved records. Property alternatives are not queries.
definitions.outcome_cross_tab: Raw Gurobi claims versus uniquely source-hash-matched ABC claims; unavailable/corrupt/unverified ABC measurements use missing_or_corrupt.
definitions.numerical_unsat: Recorded UNSAT with run time within the original deadline when known; no exact-real certificate. ABC additionally requires a unique source-hash match, not execution binding.
definitions.unresolved: No deadline-qualified accepted solve, including missing/corrupt/identity-unverified measurements, errors, timeouts and rejected or unvalidated SAT.
definitions.paired_unsat: Common deadline-qualified numerical UNSAT, both run times available, positive Gurobi time. Each summary includes exact IDs and timing counts; no timeout imputation.
definitions.ratios: ABC/Gurobi observed run seconds, not matched-hardware speedups. Preparation is separate; combined ratios require explicit source.prepare_plus_run_comparable=true.
definitions.cohorts: Audited ReLUSplitter depth/original-model descriptors, matched published MNIST outcome claims, or audited ACOPF property classes. Unavailable labels remain explicit. No cross-study pooling.

missing_inputs: Execution-bound benchmark identities for published measurements and checks
Complete artifact-matched participating-tool conflict context for UNSAT and category normalization

limitations: Published CSV and check caches do not pin execution benchmark bytes or commit
